items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: this boy, Willie Jones and I, we sneaked down the district... And this Willie, he caught on... And that's why, that's how we got our start

ctx.x: All the Canal Streets are, the New Orleans Canal Street, aren't they? Yeah. We have the Canal Street in Chicago. Yeah. Yeah. It's Canal Street in New Orleans.

So, when I was writing this other, this other thing, I thought about him many times. I said, didn't you write, he really tried to get me ahead and he called me up. I told my wife and family, I said, Mr. Jones called me up and told me, he said, don't worry, you're in.
It all depends on you. That was the first record I would make. Yeah. With Richard. With Richard. I sang.
